name: CropCircuit Michigan Farm Funding Radar
scope: Michigan-focused farm, food, conservation, and rural-business funding
disclaimer: Program status can change. CropCircuit links to the primary program source so applicants can verify details before applying.

opportunities.title: Michigan Good Food Fund 2026 Seed Awards
opportunities.summary: Seed grants for eligible businesses across Michigan's food and farm sector whose growth supports economic development and healthy food access.
opportunities.verification_note: Primary program page currently says applications are open, with $5,000–$20,000 awards and a September 28, 2026 5:00 PM EDT deadline.

opportunities.title: USDA FSA Supplemental Disaster Relief Program (SDRP)
opportunities.funding: Disaster relief payments; amount depends on eligible losses and program calculation
opportunities.audience: Agricultural producers with eligible 2023 or 2024 revenue, quality, or production losses to crops, trees, bushes, or vines
opportunities.summary: SDRP provides assistance for qualifying 2023 and 2024 disaster losses. Stage 1 covers indemnified losses using crop insurance or NAP data; Stage 2 can cover non-indemnified, uncovered, and quality losses.
opportunities.verification_note: FSA's current SDRP page and August 10, 2026 announcement state that the deadline for both Stage 1 and Stage 2 is September 30, 2026.

opportunities.title: Michigan Craft Beverage Council 2027 Research & Education Grants
opportunities.funding: Education grants up to $5,000; research grants up to $40,000
opportunities.audience: Research and education projects supporting Michigan craft beverage agriculture and markets
opportunities.summary: Current priorities include increasing use of Michigan agricultural products and regenerative practices for crops used in craft beverage production.
opportunities.verification_note: MDARD's current FY27 page and September 3 release list the program as open and proposals due October 9, 2026 at 3:00 PM ET.

opportunities.title: Michigan FSA Emergency Farm Loans — 2025 Drought, Heat, Frost/Freeze Designations
opportunities.funding: Emergency farm credit; loan amount and terms depend on losses, security, eligibility, and repayment ability
opportunities.audience: Eligible producers in designated primary or contiguous Michigan counties affected by specified 2025 drought/excessive heat and frost/freeze disasters
opportunities.summary: Secretarial disaster designations make FSA emergency credit available for eligible recovery needs. Three Michigan designations listed by FSA share an October 13, 2026 application deadline.
opportunities.verification_note: Michigan FSA's April 8, 2026 designation notice lists October 13, 2026 as the application deadline for the cited drought/excessive heat and frost/freeze designations and enumerates primary and contiguous eligible counties.

opportunities.title: NRCS Conservation Stewardship Program — Michigan
opportunities.deadline_label: Applications accepted continuously; ask NRCS about the next Michigan ranking date
opportunities.audience: Agricultural producers and land managers already using conservation practices
opportunities.summary: CSP supports producers who maintain existing conservation and add further conservation activities. Michigan applications are accepted continuously.
opportunities.verification_note: USDA NRCS Michigan currently states CSP applications are accepted continuously and ranked at key times during the year.

opportunities.title: NRCS EQIP — Michigan
opportunities.deadline_label: Applications accepted continuously; ask NRCS about the next Michigan ranking date
opportunities.audience: Agricultural producers and non-industrial private forest managers
opportunities.summary: Financial and technical assistance for conservation practices. Michigan's FY2026 first batching date has passed, but applications remain continuous and can be considered in future ranking periods.
opportunities.verification_note: USDA NRCS Michigan currently states EQIP applications are accepted continuously and ranked at state-specific dates.

opportunities.title: North Central SARE Farmer Rancher Grant
opportunities.deadline_label: No open call shown as of September 19, 2026; wait for the current call before applying
opportunities.funding: Program page lists up to $15,000 for individuals or $30,000 for teams; verify the next call when released
opportunities.audience: Farmers and ranchers in the North Central region, including Michigan, testing sustainable agriculture ideas through research, demonstration, or education
opportunities.summary: A recurring producer-focused grant for sustainable agriculture experiments and demonstrations. The current program page says there is no open call, so this is a planning/watch item rather than an active application.
opportunities.verification_note: The current NCR-SARE Farmer Rancher page says there is no open call and lists the standard individual/team maximums and annual program structure.

opportunities.title: USDA Rural Energy for America Program (REAP)
opportunities.deadline_label: Grant awards paused pending new regulations; guaranteed loans continue
opportunities.audience: Agricultural producers and rural small businesses
opportunities.summary: USDA announced that further REAP grant awards are paused until new regulations and a new funding notice are in effect. Guaranteed loans continue. This entry is kept as a status warning so applicants do not waste time on stale grant guidance.
opportunities.verification_note: USDA Rural Development's FY2026 FAQ says REAP is not accepting FY2026 RES/EEI grant applications and will not make further grant awards until new regulations are in effect; guaranteed loans continue.

opportunities.title: MDARD Specialty Crop Block Grant
opportunities.provider: Michigan Department of Agriculture & Rural Development
opportunities.funding: Project grants supporting Michigan specialty crops
opportunities.audience: Projects that enhance competitiveness of Michigan specialty crops
opportunities.summary: The 2026 application cycle is closed. CropCircuit tracks it because it is a recurring program worth planning for before the next cycle opens.
opportunities.verification_note: Tracked as a recently closed or recurring Michigan program; verify the next cycle at the linked primary source.

opportunities.title: MDARD Underserved, Value-Added, Regional Food Systems & Supply Chain Grant
opportunities.provider: Michigan Department of Agriculture & Rural Development
opportunities.audience: Michigan agriculture, processing, food systems, healthy food access, and supply-chain projects
opportunities.summary: The 2026 cycle is closed and awards were announced in September. The program is retained as a planning/watch item for future rounds.
opportunities.verification_note: Tracked as a recently closed or recurring Michigan program; verify the next cycle at the linked primary source.
